title: Unused Custom Function
description:
Unused-code rule — custom functions never called from any calculation, script or other function. Findings in files exported without DDR info are marked unverified.

Based on the PMD rule UnusedPrivateMethod — https://docs.pmd-code.org/latest/pmd_rules_java_bestpractices.html#unusedprivatemethod
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Dead custom functions carry maintenance cost with no benefit.
rule.remediation: Confirm no dynamic usage, then delete the function. In a file exported without DDR info formula references are missing, so its findings are marked unverified — export it again with DDR info before deleting.
